```sql
SELECT
  m.prompt_version,
  m.feature,
  m.setup,
  m.split,
  m.arm,
  m.tenant_id,
  m.any_cache_hit,
  m.total_cost_usd,
  m.total_latency_ms,
  m.n_calls,
  m.flags,
  m.accuracy,
  m.p50_latency_ms,
  m.p95_latency_ms
FROM
  marts.dim_prompt_version m
JOIN
  marts.fct_outcomes o ON m.prompt_version = o.prompt_version
JOIN
  marts.fct_requests r ON m.prompt_version = r.prompt_version
JOIN
  marts.mart_cost_per_outcome c ON m.prompt_version = c.prompt_version
JOIN
  support.tickets t ON o.final_request_id = t.request_id
WHERE
  t.priority = 'high'
  AND m.setup = 'local'
  AND m.arm = 'triage'
GROUP BY
  m.prompt_version,
  m.feature,
  m.setup,
  m.split,
  m.arm,
  m.tenant_id,
  m.any_cache_hit,
  m.total_cost_usd,
  m.total_latency_ms,
  m.n_calls,
  m.flags,
  m.accuracy,
  m.p50_latency_ms,
  m.p95_latency_ms
ORDER BY
  m.prompt_version,
  m.feature,
  m.setup,
  m.split,
  m.arm,
  m.tenant_id;
```

FROM

  marts.dim_tenant tenant ON fct_outcomes.tenant_id = tenant.tenant_id
JOIN
  marts.dim_prompt_version prompt_version ON fct_outcomes.prompt_version = prompt_version.prompt_version
JOIN
  marts.fct_requests fct_requests ON fct_outcomes.decision_id = fct_requests.decision_id
JOIN

    SELECT 
        f.requested_model,
        COUNT(*) AS cache_hit_count
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            fct_requests.requested_model,
            COUNT(*) AS n_calls,
            SUM(CASE WHEN fct_requests.cache_status = 'HIT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FILTER (WHERE fct_requests.cache_status = 'HIT') AS cache_hit_count
        FROM marts.fct_requests fct_requests

            fct_requests.arm = 'primary'
            AND fct_requests.split = 'test'
            AND fct_requests.any_cache_hit = true
        GROUP BY 
            fct_requests.requested_model
    ) f
    GROUP BY 
        f.requested_model
) m
WHERE 
    m.cache_hit_count > 0;
